summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lowkey Home page UI+UX overhaul. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). All 8 UI sections verified working. CRITICAL feature verified: clicking user profiles opens profile modal (NOT /search navigation).
critical_code_review_comments: Recent Activity section uses MOCKED data - activity signals (browsing, online, active, joined) are simulated from real member data when no real notifications exist. This is expected per requirements.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 sections verified, all critical flows working)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 10 users, 7 lounges, founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Home page redesign features verified working. Profile modal opens correctly from all user click points (Discover cards, Active Now avatars, Recent Activity items). The 8 sections are: 1) Discover (hero card + 2-column grid), 2) Active Now (stories + online members), 3) Recent Activity (MOCKED activity signals), 4) Featured Lounge (After Dark with LIVE indicator), 5) Lounges (5 real lounges), 6) Monetisation (Credits + Exclusive buttons), 7) Radio, 8) Bottom Navigation (Home/Lounge/After Dark/Profile).

login_flow.details: Login with kinglowkey@hotmail.com / password123 works correctly. Onboarding modal appears on first login and can be dismissed.

critical_profile_modal_from_discover.details: Clicking user cards in Discover section opens profile modal (NOT /search navigation). Modal shows user name, Connect button, Full Profile button, and Close button.

critical_profile_modal_from_active_now.details: Clicking user avatars in Active Now section opens profile modal correctly.

critical_profile_modal_from_activity.details: Clicking activity items in Recent Activity section opens profile modal correctly.

profile_modal_contents.details: Profile modal shows: user name, initials avatar (gradient background), Connect button (for non-friends), Full Profile button, Close button. Verification badges (Crown for founders, Check for verified) are implemented.

profile_modal_close.details: Close button (X) in profile modal works correctly.

discover_section.details: Discover section shows hero card (full-width) + 6 cards in 2-column grid. Cards show user initials with gradient backgrounds, display names, and 'Online' status. 'See all' button navigates to /search.

active_now_section.details: Active Now section shows Add Story button (dashed border, + icon) + 9 online member avatars in horizontal scroll. Green online dots visible.

add_story_modal.details: Add Story button opens story creation modal with Photo/Video/Text tabs.

recent_activity_section.details: Recent Activity shows 4 activity items with real user names and activity signals (browsing, online, active, joined). NOTE: Activity data is MOCKED from real member data.

featured_lounge_section.details: Featured Lounge shows After Dark with 'LIVE' indicator, description 'Private. Discreet. For those who want more.', member count, and 'Enter' CTA button.

lounges_section.details: Lounges section shows 5 real lounges (Night Owls, Chill Vibes Only, Music Lovers, Late Night Talks, Music Corner) with colored accent bars. 'All' button present.

monetisation_section.details: Monetisation section has Credits button (gold wallet icon, credit count 0) and Exclusive button (red lock icon, 'Unlock content').

radio_section.details: Radio section has Radio button with 'Listen while you browse' subtitle. Button navigates to /radio.

bottom_navigation.details: Bottom navigation has 4 tabs: Home (purple active), Lounge, After Dark, Profile. All tabs are clickable.

header_elements.details: Header shows: LowKey logo, credit balance button (0), Verified badge, sound toggle, notification bell, settings, logout.

api_auth_login.details: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with user object and token. Uses 'identifier' field for email/displayName.

api_users.details: GET /api/users returns 200 with list of 10 users for Discover section.

api_profile.details: GET /api/profile/{userId}?viewerId={viewerId} returns 200 with profile data including displayName, verified, isFounder fields.

api_lounges.details: GET /api/lounges returns 200 with list of 7 lounges.

mocked_data.recent_activity: Recent Activity section shows real member names with simulated activity signals (browsing, online, active, joined recently) when no real notifications exist. This is expected per requirements.

visual_verification.discover_section: Hero card full-width at top, 2-column grid below with gradient backgrounds (blue, pink, gold, purple variations), user initials, display names, green online dots
visual_verification.active_now: Horizontal scroll with Add Story button (dashed border, + icon), user avatars with gradient borders and green online dots
visual_verification.recent_activity: Activity feed with colored icons (blue eye for browsing, green users for online, pink heart for active, gold user-plus for joined) and timestamps
visual_verification.featured_lounge: Dark card with After Dark title, LIVE indicator (gold dot + text), description, member count, and Enter CTA button
visual_verification.lounges_list: Simple list format with colored accent bars (blue, green, gold, purple, pink), lounge names, and chevron icons
visual_verification.monetisation: Two buttons side by side - Credits (gold wallet icon, credit count) and Exclusive (red lock icon, 'Unlock content')
visual_verification.radio: Card with red radio icon, 'Radio' title, 'Listen while you browse' subtitle, and chevron
visual_verification.bottom_nav: 4 tabs with Home having purple active state, others in muted white
